definition: Varun Mohan is an American entrepreneur and software engineer.
details: Built GPU virtualization infrastructure (Exafunction) and pivoted to create Codeium and the Windsurf agentic IDE. He is the co-founder and former chief executive officer of Windsurf.

explainer.lead: Varun Mohan is an American software engineer.

contributions.name: In 2021, Mohan co-founded Codeium with Douglas Chen.

timeline.what: In July 2025, Google announced that Mohan, Chen, and several members of Windsurf's research team would join Google DeepMind.
